items.title: Insights from a double-blind, randomized, direct-to-participant intervention trial for Long COVID
items.summary: Background. Long COVID affects an estimated 400 million people worldwide, and is associated with low quality of life. items.title: Trial By Error: Canada’s McMaster University Launches Trial of Lightning Process for Long Covid
items.summary: By David Tuller, DrPH McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, has launched a clinical trial of the Lightning Process (LP), a well-known “mind-body” intervention, as a treatment for Long Covid. items.summary_short: By David Tuller, DrPH McMaster University in Hamilton, Ontario, has launched a clinical trial of the Lightning Process (LP), a well-known “mind-body” intervention, as a treatment for Long Covid. The study, called Fatigue in Long COVID, or FALCON, was registered last month on ClinicalTrials.gov.
